identity.title: List of Pokémon Adventures XY volumes

leadText:
Due to chapters taking at least two years before being collected into a volume, the of Pokémon Adventures was separately collected into mini-volumes by Shogakukan in Japan, which began in April 2014 and ended in December 2016. The chapters included in these mini-volumes were only ones that were published in the magazine CoroCoro Ichiban. Once the ended in the regular volumes, the X & Y arc started to be properly collected in that format as well.

These volumes have also been localized in English by Shogakukan Asia, in by Kurokawa, in by Panini Comics and in by Norma Editorial.
